item.title: Solved: Class Inheritance Issues in Python 3.7 Dataclasses
item.description:
Solved: Class Inheritance Issues in Python 3.7 Dataclasses

If you’re working with Python’s dataclasses, you’ve likely come across issues when trying to implement inheritance in your class structures. One common problem arises when you attempt to have default parameters in your parent class while defining non-default parameters in a child class — this can lead to errors like TypeError: non-default argument 'school' follows default argument. This comprehensive guide will explore different approaches to tackle this issue effectively.
